text: Afua's running the Cardiff half on 2 November 2026. First proper race since her knee op and she sounded really jittery about it. Text her good luck the night before.
graham veggie now, not pescatarian anymore. also off booze till xmas
Katarzyna mentioned her brother Gintaras is playing bass at the Lexington sometime next week. She's going with her boyfriend. Might tag along if I'm free.
Lola - coeliac, properly strict, separate toaster etc. Remember for the 14th.

Remind me to ring Jamal the day after his driving test, it's Thursday morning. He's failed twice already and his dad keeps winding him up about it, which really doesn't help. He's booked extra lessons with a new instructor this time and says he feels better about roundabouts now. Fingers crossed. If he passes, owes me a pint.
Kiara and Xavier are doing the Bristol 10k together end of the month. Matching t-shirts apparently.
Teresa's recital is off, the hall flooded. They're hoping to rebook for early March but nothing confirmed.
pick up oat milk, bin bags, batteries for the smoke alarm

Chat with Sophie over lunch. She hates coriander with a passion, says it tastes like soap. Loves anything with miso though, and she's getting into natural wine. Her mum's turning 70 in March 2027 and they're planning a big family meal, probably the Korean place on Mill Road. Her brother Xavier is flying in from Montreal for it.
Isabel's daughter is in the school production of Oliver, plays the Artful Dodger. Two shows, Friday and Saturday evening. Isabel very proud.
Yaw - allergic to shellfish (serious, carries an epipen). Prefers rum to whisky.
Need to book tickets for the Ioana Bianchi gig before they sell out, she said they're going fast. Saturday 21st November.
so Nasser's been picked for the county cricket squad, first match is sometime over the summer they don't have fixtures yet. he's buzzing. must send him a congrats message tonight
Mrs Kowalski next door had her hip done last week. Her son Pieter is staying with her till the end of the month. Pop round with soup at the weekend.
Rin doesn't drink coffee at all, only green tea or that barley stuff. Ordered her a latte today like an idiot.

Chen's band, The Low Hums, playing the Brudenell on 12 December 2026. Chen on drums, his first gig back since he broke his wrist in the summer. I'm going with Luca and Sana, we're getting food beforehand somewhere near Hyde Park. Sana's veggie so not the burger place. Remind me to book a table that week.
Ruby says Hemi has been really struggling since the redundancy, barely leaving the house. She's worried. I should give him a call sometime this week, not just text.
Don't forget Mustafa's chess tournament results come out Monday. Message him that evening to see how he did.
Luis is doing keto again. Third time this year. No bread, no beer, no fun.
Kwame's dog Biscuit had to have a tooth out yesterday. Poor thing. Kwame was more stressed than the dog.
Vikram - vegan, but eats honey, which apparently is a big debate in his house. Partner Alice is not vegan at all and they cook separately most nights.
note to self: dentist moved to 3 November 2026, 9.40

Gustavo flying back to São Paulo early December for his sister's wedding. Gone three weeks. He's best man and terrified about the speech, has rewritten it about six times already and wants to read it to me sometime next week. Remind me to send him a good luck message the morning of the wedding, and maybe drop off a little bottle of cachaça the week before he goes, he loves the stuff.
Agnieszka mentioned she'd love one of those fancy Japanese knives for her birthday. Birthday is mid January.
Ebony finished the Great North Swim on Sunday!! Sub one hour. Need to get her a card.

Graham's son Luca is in the under 12s cup final this Saturday at 10, at the rec. Graham's coaching and is more nervous than the kids. Luca's playing in goal. I said I'd come down and bring orange slices and a flask. Afterwards they're all going for pizza if they win, Graham says Luca only eats margherita, nothing else, ever.
Teresa - lactose intolerant but will eat hard cheese. Big fan of red wine, especially Rioja.
Ifeoma Adeyemi (Ify) has her viva on 4 December. She's been rewriting her intro chapter for weeks and is a nervous wreck. I need to send her something nice the day before, flowers maybe.
How did Kiara's audition go? It was on Tuesday. Must ask next time I see her.
Sana's twins are in the swimming gala on the 8th. She asked if I could give them a lift after school that day. Said yes.
Jamal Thomas, works in procurement at the council, met him through Sophie. Into fantasy football and spicy food, the hotter the better.
Book group moved to the last Wednesday of the month, my place. Need to do snacks. Remember Lola's coeliac and Yaw can't have shellfish.
Xavier said his dad's retiring at Easter after forty years at the depot. Big do planned. Maybe chip in for the gift.
Afua and Kwame's anniversary dinner got cancelled, she's got flu. They're going to try again sometime next week.
Alice - pescatarian, hates mushrooms, likes gin and tonics with cucumber not lime
Remind me to text Pieter the week after his marathon to see how his calf held up. London, 26 April 2027.
rang mum. she's fine. nothing new really

Mustafa's niece is performing at the Royal Albert Hall with the national youth orchestra in March 2027, she plays the cello. Whole family's going, his parents are coming over from Izmir specially. He's sorting tickets for everyone and stressing about the seating plan because his aunts don't get on. Said he'd let me know if there's a spare.
Isabel told me Luis finally proposed! In Lisbon over the summer apparently and they kept it quiet till now. Wedding probably spring 2028.
Ioana's starting a sourdough course at the community centre in early March. She's obsessed. Wants a proofing basket, good gift idea for later.
Need to call the venue about the deposit before Friday.
Hemi's daughter Rin is in her first ballet show on Saturday 28 November 2026. Hemi asked me to film it as he's working. Bring the good camera, charge it the night before.

Vikram says his boss is a nightmare and he's job hunting. Has a second interview with an insurance firm on the 11th, then possibly a third round sometime before the end of the month. Sounded quite flat about it all, like he's given up a bit. His wife Alice is pushing him to go freelance instead. Need to text him on the 11th after it finishes.
Katarzyna loves pierogi but only her babcia's, won't touch shop bought. Also a huge Arsenal fan, season ticket holder.

I'm doing the cake for Ruby's surprise party on the 30th. Chocolate, she's not keen on fruit cake, and her girlfriend Ebony is gluten free so maybe do a separate small one. Party's at the Crown upstairs room from 7. Need to order the candles by Wednesday and confirm numbers with Ebony the day before.
Chen's wife Teresa is due in February. First baby. They've just found out it's a girl.
Sophie can't do nuts at all, anaphylactic. Remember when booking Thursday's dinner.
Gustavo's quiz team won the pub league last night. He's insufferable now.
Must remember to ask Nasser that evening how his mum's scan went. It's Wednesday afternoon. She's been really anxious about it.
Ebony's moving to Leeds over the summer for the new job. Her partner Mustafa's staying here till their flat sells. Long distance for a bit.
gym 6am tomorrow then meal prep. try that lentil thing

Long call with Agnieszka tonight. Her dad's in hospital again, the heart thing, they think he'll be in till the end of the week at least. She's driving down to Gdańsk on Saturday and staying maybe ten days. She sounded exhausted and said work's been brutal too. Her cat Kluska needs feeding while she's away, I said I'd do it. I should check in with her Sunday evening once she's settled.
Kiara's partner Hemi is in a play at the Arts Theatre, Twelfth Night, plays Malvolio. Runs 18 to 22 November 2026. Get tickets for the Friday.
Yaw's sister Ifeoma graduates from nursing in July. He keeps saying how proud he is.
Lola's dad passed away last month. She's back at work but quiet. Don't forget to ask her for coffee sometime next week, just us.
Pieter only drinks alcohol-free beer now, been sober two years. Loves a Sunday roast, particularly lamb.
Luca's band is playing at a wedding fair in early March, first paid gig. He's chuffed. Reminds me, his birthday's 9 March and he's been hinting about a new tuner pedal.
Graham and his wife Isabel are off to Rome end of the month for their 25th. I'm feeding their goldfish. Text Graham the day before they fly to get the key sorted.
Ioana won the regional pastry competition yesterday!! She's through to the nationals in Manchester on 6 February 2027. Send congrats, then remind me to text her good luck the week before.
Kwame - type 1 diabetic. Still loves desserts, just plans around them. Mentioned he's training for a triathlon, maybe next summer.
